gloss: He shows you the lightning, causing fear and hope
And the thunder exalts Him with praise
The root the English cannot carry — to settle, to come to rest
Bow — until you are settled. Then rise. Then prostrate.

ar: لَوْلَا أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِ
gloss: Why has no sign been sent down to him from his Lord?
Content with the life of this world, and settled into it
A different root — the family of sakan, a dwelling, a place you stop
Sent down — the verb used for rain, and for revelation

ar: إِنَّمَا أَشْكُو بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي إِلَى اللَّهِ
gloss: I complain of my anguish and my grief only to Allah
Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts settle
